About

Shun Kwok

History, digital media,
and the systems behind them.

I work on historical strategy games and digital media. Here I collect my projects, the ideas behind them, and notes from their development.

My current projects are Steam and Steel, a modification for Medieval II: Total War, and newsletter-media.com, a media start-up supported by the Meerkat publishing system.
